The '''Koler system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained the star of the [[Koler|same name]]. The system held a few rugged [[Planet/Legends|planets]], an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and a debris field of derelict [[starship]]s.<ref name="Lessons" />
